292|def _create_hyp_class_and_strat(
293|    attrs_and_strategy: list[tuple[_CountingAttr, SearchStrategy[PosArg]]],
294|) -> SearchStrategy[tuple[type, SearchStrategy[PosArgs], SearchStrategy[KwArgs]]]:
295|    def key(t):
296|        return (t[0].default is not NOTHING, t[0].kw_only or False)
297|
298|    attrs_and_strat = sorted(attrs_and_strategy, key=key)
299|    attrs = [a[0] for a in attrs_and_strat]
300|    for i, a in enumerate(attrs):
301|        a.counter = i
302|    vals = tuple((a[1]) for a in attrs_and_strat if not a[0].kw_only)
303|    kwarg_strats = {}
304|    for attr_name, attr_and_strat in zip(gen_attr_names(), attrs_and_strat):

306|            if attr_name.startswith("_"):
307|                attr_name = attr_name[1:]

309|    return tuples(
310|        just(make_class("HypClass", dict(zip(gen_attr_names(), attrs)))),
311|        just(tuples(*vals)),

104|def test_sentinels(
105|    converter_factory: Callable[..., Converter], detailed_validation: bool
106|):
107|    """All backends serialize sentinel names and restore singleton fields and unions."""
108|    from builtins import sentinel
109|
110|    missing = sentinel("MISSING")
111|    unset = sentinel("UNSET")
112|
113|    @define
114|    class Example:
115|        single: missing = missing
116|        number: int | missing = missing
117|        text: str | missing = missing
118|        multiple: missing | unset = unset
119|        values: list[int | missing] = field(factory=lambda: [missing, 1])
120|
121|    converter = converter_factory(detailed_validation=detailed_validation)
122|    assert converter.unstructure(missing) == "MISSING"
123|    assert converter.structure("MISSING", missing) is missing
124|
125|    for original in (Example(), Example(number=1, text="other")):
126|        unstructured = converter.unstructure(original)
127|        assert unstructured == {
128|            "single": "MISSING",
129|            "number": "MISSING" if original.number is missing else 1,
130|            "text": "MISSING" if original.text is missing else "other",
131|            "multiple": "UNSET",
132|            "values": ["MISSING", 1],
133|        }
134|        restored = converter.loads(converter.dumps(original), Example)
135|        assert restored == original
136|        assert restored.single is missing
137|        assert restored.multiple is unset
138|        assert restored.values[0] is missing

286|def native_unions(
287|    draw: DrawFn,
288|    include_strings=True,
289|    include_floats=True,
290|    include_nones=True,
291|    include_bytes=True,
292|    include_datetimes=True,
293|    include_objectids=False,
294|    include_literals=True,
295|) -> tuple[Any, Any]:
296|    types = [bool, int]
297|    strats = {bool: booleans(), int: integers()}
298|    if include_strings:
299|        types.append(str)
300|        strats[str] = text()
301|    if include_floats:
302|        types.append(float)
303|        strats[float] = floats(allow_nan=False)
304|    if include_nones:
305|        types.append(None)
306|        strats[None] = just(None)
307|    if include_bytes:
308|        types.append(bytes)
309|        strats[bytes] = binary()
310|    if include_datetimes:
311|        types.append(datetime)
312|        strats[datetime] = datetimes(
313|            min_value=datetime(1970, 1, 1), max_value=datetime(2038, 1, 1)
314|        )
315|    if include_objectids:
316|        types.append(ObjectId)
317|        strats[ObjectId] = builds(ObjectId)
318|
319|    chosen_types = draw(sets(sampled_from(types), min_size=2))
320|
321|    if include_literals:
322|        from typing import Literal
323|
324|        # We can replace some of the types with 1+ literal types.
325|        if str in chosen_types:
326|            strat = draw(sampled_from(["leave", "literal", "newtype"]))
327|            if strat == "literal":
328|                chosen_types.remove(str)
329|                vals = draw(sets(text(), min_size=1, max_size=2))
330|                for lit in vals:
331|                    t = Literal[lit]
332|                    chosen_types.add(t)
333|                    strats[t] = just(lit)
334|            elif strat == "newtype":
335|                chosen_types.remove(str)
336|                chosen_types.add(NewStr)
337|                strats[NewStr] = strats.pop(str)
338|        if bool in chosen_types:
339|            strat = draw(sampled_from(["leave", "literal", "newtype"]))
340|            if strat == "literal":
341|                chosen_types.remove(bool)
342|                val = draw(booleans())
343|                t = Literal[val]
344|                chosen_types.add(t)
345|                strats[t] = just(val)
346|            elif strat == "newtype":
347|                chosen_types.remove(bool)
348|                chosen_types.add(NewBool)
349|                strats[NewBool] = strats.pop(bool)
350|        if int in chosen_types:
351|            strat = draw(sampled_from(["leave", "literal", "newtype"]))
352|            if strat == "literal":
353|                chosen_types.remove(int)
354|                vals = draw(sets(integers(), min_size=1, max_size=2))
355|                for val in vals:
356|                    t = Literal[val]
357|                    chosen_types.add(t)
358|                    strats[t] = just(val)
359|            elif strat == "newtype":
360|                # NewTypes instead.
361|                chosen_types.remove(int)
362|                chosen_types.add(NewInt)
363|                strats[NewInt] = strats.pop(int)
364|
365|    return Union[tuple(chosen_types)], draw(one_of(*[strats[t] for t in chosen_types]))

138|@composite
139|def simple_typeddicts(
140|    draw: DrawFn,
141|    total: Optional[bool] = None,
142|    not_required: bool = False,
143|    min_attrs: int = 0,
144|    typeddict_cls: Optional[Any] = None,
145|) -> tuple[TypedDictType, dict]:
146|    """Generate simple typed dicts.
147|
148|    :param total: Generate the given totality dicts (default = random)
149|    """
150|    if total is None:
151|        total = draw(booleans())
152|
153|    attrs = draw(
154|        lists(
155|            int_attributes(total, not_required)
156|            | annotated_int_attributes(total, not_required)
157|            | list_of_int_attributes(total, not_required)
158|            | datetime_attributes(total, not_required),
159|            min_size=min_attrs,
160|        )
161|    )
162|
163|    attrs_dict = {n: attr[0] for n, attr in zip(gen_typeddict_attr_names(), attrs)}
164|    success_payload = {}
165|    for n, a in zip(attrs_dict, attrs):
166|        v = draw(a[1])
167|        if v is not NOTHING:
168|            success_payload[n] = v
169|
170|    cls = (
171|        (TypedDict if draw(booleans()) else ExtensionsTypedDict)
172|        if typeddict_cls is None
173|        else typeddict_cls
174|    )("HypTypedDict", attrs_dict, total=total)
175|
176|    note(
177|        "\n".join(
178|            [
179|                f"class HypTypedDict(TypedDict{'' if total else ', total=False'}):",
180|                *[f"    {n}: {a}" for n, a in attrs_dict.items()],
181|            ]
182|        )
183|    )
184|
185|    if draw(booleans()):
186|
187|        class InheritedTypedDict(cls):
188|            inherited: int
189|
190|        cls = InheritedTypedDict
191|        success_payload["inherited"] = draw(integers())
192|
193|    return (cls, success_payload)

199|) -> tuple[TypedDictType, dict, set[str]]:
200|    """Generate TypedDicts, with the instances having extra keys."""
201|    cls, success = draw(simple_typeddicts(total, typeddict_cls=typeddict_cls))

210|@composite
211|def generic_typeddicts(draw: DrawFn, total: bool = True) -> tuple[TypedDictType, dict]:
212|    """Generate generic typed dicts.
213|
214|    :param total: Generate the given totality dicts
215|    """
216|    attrs = draw(
217|        lists(
218|            int_attributes(total)
219|            | list_of_int_attributes(total)
220|            | datetime_attributes(total),
221|            min_size=1,
222|        )
223|    )
224|
225|    attrs_dict = {n: attr[0] for n, attr in zip(gen_attr_names(), attrs)}
226|    success_payload = {}
227|    for n, a in zip(attrs_dict, attrs):
228|        v = draw(a[1])
229|        if v is not NOTHING:
230|            success_payload[n] = v
231|
232|    # We choose up to 3 attributes and make them generic.
233|    generic_attrs = draw(
234|        lists(integers(0, len(attrs) - 1), min_size=1, max_size=3, unique=True)
235|    )
236|    generics = []
237|    actual_types = []
238|    for ix, (attr_name, attr_type) in enumerate(list(attrs_dict.items())):
239|        if ix in generic_attrs:
240|            typevar = TypeVar(f"T{ix + 1}")
241|            generics.append(typevar)
242|            if total and draw(booleans()):
243|                # We might decide to make these NotRequired
244|                typevar = NotRequired[typevar]
245|            actual_types.append(attr_type)
246|            attrs_dict[attr_name] = typevar
247|
248|    cls = make_typeddict(
249|        "HypTypedDict", attrs_dict, total=total, bases=[Generic[tuple(generics)]]
250|    )
251|
252|    if draw(booleans()):
253|
254|        class InheritedTypedDict(cls[tuple(actual_types)]):
255|            inherited: int
256|
257|        cls = InheritedTypedDict
258|        success_payload["inherited"] = draw(integers())
259|    else:
260|        cls = cls[tuple(actual_types)]
261|
262|    return (cls, success_payload)

265|def make_typeddict(
266|    cls_name: str, attrs: dict[str, type], total: bool = True, bases: list = []
267|) -> TypedDictType:
268|    globs = {"TypedDict": TypedDict}
269|    lines = []
270|
271|    bases_snippet = ", ".join(f"_base{ix}" for ix in range(len(bases)))
272|    for ix, base in enumerate(bases):
273|        globs[f"_base{ix}"] = base
274|    bases_snippet = f", {bases_snippet}"
275|
276|    lines.append(f"class {cls_name}(TypedDict{bases_snippet}, total={total}):")
277|    for n, t in attrs.items():
278|        # Strip the initial underscore if present, to prevent mangling.
279|        trimmed = n[1:] if n.startswith("_") else n
280|        globs[f"_{trimmed}_type"] = t
281|        lines.append(f"  {n}: _{trimmed}_type")
282|
283|    script = "\n".join(lines)
284|
285|    note_lines = script
286|    for n, t in globs.items():
287|        if n == "TypedDict":
288|            continue
289|        note_lines = note_lines.replace(n, repr(t))
290|    note(note_lines)
291|
292|    eval(compile(script, "name", "exec"), globs)
293|
294|    return globs[cls_name]

55|def get_annot(t) -> dict:
56|    """Our version, handling type vars properly."""
57|    if is_generic(t):
58|        # This will have typevars.
59|        origin = getattr(t, "__origin__", None)
60|        if origin is not None:
61|            origin_annotations = get_annots(origin)
62|            args = t.__args__
63|            params = origin.__parameters__
64|            param_to_args = dict(zip(params, args))
65|            res = {}
66|            for k, v in origin_annotations.items():
67|                if (nrb := get_notrequired_base(v)) is not NOTHING:
68|                    res[k] = (
69|                        NotRequired[param_to_args[nrb]] if nrb in param_to_args else v
70|                    )
71|                else:
72|                    res[k] = param_to_args.get(v, v)
73|            return res
74|
75|        # Origin is `None`, so this is a subclass for a generic typeddict.
76|        mapping = generate_mapping(t)
77|        res = {}
78|        for k, v in get_annots(t).items():
79|            if (nrb := get_notrequired_base(v)) is not NOTHING:
80|                res[k] = (
81|                    NotRequired[mapping[nrb.__name__]] if nrb.__name__ in mapping else v
82|                )
83|            else:
84|                res[k] = mapping.get(v.__name__, v)
85|        return res
86|    return get_annots(t)

121|    not-yet-pinned class was forced into the single fallback slot, so some
122|    member orderings raised ``TypeError`` even though a valid assignment exists.
123|    Here A is identified by ``a``, B by ``ab`` (once A is pinned), and C by

8|from cattrs.errors import (
9|    BaseValidationError,
10|    ClassValidationError,
11|    ForbiddenExtraKeysError,
12|    IterableValidationError,
13|    StructureHandlerNotFoundError,
14|)
15|
16|
17|@pytest.mark.parametrize(
18|    "err_cls, err_args",
19|    [
20|        (StructureHandlerNotFoundError, ("Structure Message", int)),
21|        (ForbiddenExtraKeysError, ("Forbidden Message", int, {"foo", "bar"})),
22|        (ForbiddenExtraKeysError, ("", str, {"foo", "bar"})),
23|        (ForbiddenExtraKeysError, (None, list, {"foo", "bar"})),
24|        (
25|            BaseValidationError,
26|            ("BaseValidation Message", [ValueError("Test BaseValidation")], int),
27|        ),
28|        (
29|            IterableValidationError,
30|            ("IterableValidation Msg", [ValueError("Test IterableValidation")], int),
31|        ),
32|        (
33|            ClassValidationError,
34|            ("ClassValidation Message", [ValueError("Test ClassValidation")], int),
35|        ),
36|    ],
37|)
38|def test_errors_pickling(
39|    err_cls: type[Exception], err_args: tuple[Any, ...], tmp_path: Path
40|) -> None:
41|    """Test if a round of pickling and unpickling works for errors."""
42|    before = err_cls(*err_args)
43|
44|    assert before.args == err_args
45|    after = pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(before))  # noqa: S301
46|
47|    assert isinstance(after, err_cls)
48|
49|    assert str(after) == str(before)
50|
51|    if issubclass(err_cls, ExceptionGroup):
52|        assert after.message == before.message
53|        assert after.args[0] == before.args[0]
54|
55|        # We need to do the exceptions within the group (i.e. args[1])
56|        # separately, as on unpickling new objects are created and hence
57|        # they will never be equal to the original ones.
58|        for after_exc, before_exc in zip(after.exceptions, before.exceptions):
59|            assert str(after_exc) == str(before_exc)
60|
61|        # The problem with args[1] might be also for other parameters, but
62|        # we ignore this here and if needed then we need a separate test
63|        assert after.args[2:] == before.args[2:]
64|
65|    else:
66|        assert after.args == err_args
67|        assert after.args == before.args
68|
69|    assert after.__cause__ == before.__cause__
70|    assert after.__context__ == before.__context__
71|    assert after.__traceback__ == before.__traceback__

6|
7|
8|def to_camel_case(snake_str):
9|    components = snake_str.split("_")
10|    return components[0] + "".join(x.title() for x in components[1:])

13|def test_snake_to_camel(converter_cls):

22|        a_snake_case_inner: Inner
23|
24|    converter = converter_cls()
25|
26|    def unstructure_adapt_to_camel_case(type):
27|        return make_dict_unstructure_fn(
28|            type,
29|            converter,
30|            **{a.name: override(rename=to_camel_case(a.name)) for a in fields(type)},
31|        )
32|
33|    converter.register_unstructure_hook_factory(has, unstructure_adapt_to_camel_case)
34|

41|            "aSnakeCaseFloat": 0.0,
42|            "aSnakeCaseStr": "str",
43|        }
44|    }
45|
46|    def structure_adapt_to_camel_case(type):
47|        overrides = {
48|            a.name: override(rename=to_camel_case(a.name)) for a in fields(type)

50|        return make_dict_structure_fn(type, converter, **overrides)

52|    converter.register_structure_hook_factory(has, structure_adapt_to_camel_case)

1|# Security Policy

3|
4|## Versioning and Backwards Compatibility
5|
6|_cattrs_ follows [*CalVer*](https://calver.org) and we only support the latest PyPI version, due to limited resources.
7|We aim to support all Python versions that are not end-of-life; older versions will be dropped to ease the maintenance burden.
8|
9|Our goal is to never undertake major breaking changes (the kinds that would necessitate a v2 if we were following SemVer).
10|Minor breaking changes may be undertaken to improve the developer experience and robustness of the library.
11|All breaking changes are prominently called out in the changelog, alongside any customization steps that may be used to restore previous behavior, when applicable.
12|
13|APIs may be marked as provisional.
14|These are not guaranteed to be stable and may change or be removed without prior notice.
15|
16|## Security Contact Information
17|
18|To report a security vulnerability, please use the [Tidelift security contact](https://tidelift.com/security).
